# Knowledge-Core: Workflows

Work only on the existing `dev` branch. Generate with repository scripts or `make generate`; after Go module changes run `make tidy`.

Every change must pass `make ci`. Go concurrency or lifecycle changes also run `make race`. Node fixture changes under `services/collaboration/interop` run `npm ci` then `npm run ci`. IDL changes additionally run `go run ./scripts/idlguard compat-git <merge-base> idl`.

Command maps remain in the generated workflows appendix.

<!-- fact:workflows.development status:verified sources:user-confirmed, user-confirmed-schema-v2-rerecord -->

Pushes to `dev` run `.github/workflows/pipeline.yml` from `.ci/pipeline.yaml` on the `ci-templates` ARC runner image; the repository does not ship an in-repo `ci_run` control image. Quality and deploy jobs use `hls-standard` (non-privileged containers, request 2 CPU / 1Gi, limit 4 CPU / 4Gi, min 1 max 8; namespace quota 32 CPU / 32Gi, pods 12). The standard namespace is Pod Security privileged only so eight runners can share hostPath `/var/lib/hls-ci-cache` at `/cache` (`CARGO_HOME`, `GOMODCACHE`, `GOCACHE`, `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE`, `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`, `RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE`); GitHub Actions cache is not used. Image builds use `hls-builder` (privileged Docker-in-Docker 4 CPU / 4Gi plus runner 4 CPU / 1Gi, min 0 max 8; CPU/memory ResourceQuota stays 64 CPU / 40Gi, pods 10). Workflow `max-parallel` is 8. External HTTP(S) uses `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`=`http://10.42.0.1:10991` from the `arc-proxy` Secret in the standard, builder, and `arc-system` namespaces; `NO_PROXY` covers localhost, loopbacks, `.svc`, the Kubernetes API, Harbor, Argo, and `.happyladysauce.local`. `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` remains so Node 24 actions including `create-github-app-token` post honor that proxy. Go modules use `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct`. The Makefile sets `AVAILABLE_CPUS` from cgroup `cpu.max` / CFS quota (capped at 8) and `BUILD_JOBS` to `BUILD_CPU_PERCENT` (default 75%) of that value; `BUILD_JOBS` remains an explicit emergency override; golangci-lint timeout is 15m. Go/Rust gate artifact uploads set `include-hidden-files` because `.ci-artifacts` is a hidden directory. All six service images use Harbor `ubuntu:24.04` (glibc 2.39, matching ARC runners). Go images stay `CGO_ENABLED=0` and add `ca-certificates` (uid 65532). Collaboration copies the prebuilt binary, adds `ca-certificates` plus `libssl3t64`, and fails the image build if `ldd` reports missing libraries. The pipeline runs `make ci` and Collaboration Node interop checks on Node 24.18.1 from npmmirror, without GitHub Actions npm cache restore; `npm audit` uses `https://registry.npmjs.org` because npmmirror does not implement the security advisories API; detects affected services; warms pinned `ubuntu:24.04` into Harbor in `prewarm-base-images` which needs only `plan` so it runs beside the Go/Rust gates; builds affected images using only the Harbor registry cache; and publishes the `dev` tag without image scanning or signing. The current `dev` image is kept as `previous` before replacement. Knowledge-Core/deploy is the editable deploy source; CI copies it to the Knowledge-Core/deploy snapshot in HappyLadySauceM/deploy, updates root image digests, and pushes with a fast-forward compare-and-swap check and bounded retry using the `knowledge-core-release` ServiceAccount and in-cluster `https://kubernetes.default.svc:443`. `deploy-release` checkouts use `fetch-depth: 0` so `origin/main` ancestry checks succeed. Deploy-only changes skip image builds but run deployment validation, GitOps synchronization, Argo health, and dev smoke before promoting `dev` to `main`; code changes run the complete image chain. If Argo or smoke fails, CI restores the exact GitOps snapshot commit with an ordinary fast-forward and moves each affected Harbor `previous` tag back to `dev`; rollback refuses to overwrite if the remote branch moved. After success, `previous` tags must be deleted for Harbor GC; cleanup failure blocks release. DeepSeek release summary failure blocks promotion to `main`. On success, `dev` fast-forwards to `main` and creates one aggregate `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` Git tag and GitHub Release, both pointing at the exact promotion commit SHA; the Release title matches the version tag. Existing knowledge-core-v* tags still count when choosing the next patch or retrying a prefixed tagged commit. Retrying the same commit reuses the matching aggregate tag and existing Release, but rejects a tag that points at another commit. Shared history is never force-pushed or rebased. The `release` environment is limited to `dev` and supplies `GH_APP_ID`, `GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`, kubeconfig, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. `pipeline.yml` ends with an `if: always()` `notify` job on `hls-standard` that posts a CI Feishu card (title, duration, artifacts, run link) through HappyLadySauceM/ci-templates `.github/actions/feishu-notify`. Independent `.github/workflows/feishu-notify.yml` posts pull_request, pull_request_review, issues, issue_comment, and release events only (no `workflow_run` or `push`); it uses organization secrets `FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL` and `FEISHU_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, does not use the `release` environment, and a notify failure does not fail `knowledge-core-pipeline`.

<!-- fact:cicd.pipeline status:verified sources:.github/workflows/pipeline.yml, filesystem:ci-config, user-confirmed, user-confirmed-4x8-hostpath-ubuntu-runtime, user-confirmed-arc-8x8-feishu-fold, user-confirmed-builder-12-12-plus-12-2, user-confirmed-cicd-ratio-and-source-deploy-sync, user-confirmed-en-locale-source, user-confirmed-feishu-notify, user-confirmed-runner-migration -->

Run `make ci` after every change; it covers check and generate-check, including Go and Rust format checks, vet/clippy, lint, non-cached tests, build, vulnerability/supply-chain checks, and generated-file drift. Go concurrency, goroutine, orchestration, or lifecycle work also runs `make race`. Node fixture changes run `npm ci && npm run ci` under `services/collaboration/interop`. IDL changes also regenerate, review wire/API compatibility, and run `go run ./scripts/idlguard compat-git <merge-base> idl`.
